Visa regime
Nationals of the Kyrgyz Republic are required to obtain a visa to enter Montenegro.
If you are unable to contact the diplomatic-consular mission of Montenegro, you can contact the VFS Global office in Bishkek.
Address: Kiev St. 62, 4th floor, Business Center 'Eurasia', Bishkek.
Diplomatic relations
On June 24, 2009, the Kyrgyz Republic recognized Montenegro as an independent and sovereign state, when diplomatic relations were established by exchanging diplomatic notes.
Bilateral relations can be rated as friendly and good. Although bilateral cooperation between Montenegro and the Kyrgyz two countries has not been framed by official visits and signed bilateral agreements, two sides has identified mutual interest in many fields of cooperation. In that sense, two countries have mutually initiated the harmonization of several bilateral agreements, on which finalization they are actively working on.
Montenegro and the Kyrgyz Republic officialy represented to the other country on a non-resident basis, through their Embassies in Moscow, Russian Federation.
Official visits
There were neither high-level incoming, nor outgoing visits.
Encounters on the margins
June 2021 - Minister of Foreign Affairs of Montenegro Đorđe Radulović met with the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic Ruslan Kazakbayev, on the margins of Antalya Diplomatic Forum.
May 16, 2011 - Minister of Foreign Affairs of Montenegro Milan Roćen met with the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic on the sidelines of the Ministerial Meeting "Global Governance and Security Council Reform" in Rome.
December 2, 2009 - Minister of Foreign Affairs of Montenegro Milan Roćen met with the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic Kadyrbek Telmanovich Sarbayev on the sidelines of the OSCE Ministerial Conference in Athens.
December 4, 2008 - Minister of Foreign Affairs of Montenegro Milan Roćen met with Kyrgyz Foreign Minister Ednan Karabayev on the sidelines of the OSCE Ministerial Conference in Helsinki.
Economic cooperation
In 2022 trade exchange between Montenegro and the Kyrgyz Republic amounted to 1,16 thousand EUR in export and 645,87 thousands EUR in import.
Foreign direct investments in 2022 form Kyrgyz Republic to Montenegro amounted 955,66 thousand EUR, outflow to Kyrgyz Republic 500 thousands EUR.
